history.subject: Picard separatedness brick 3: pullback along the projection is injective on Cech Picard groups. Refinement injectivity in degree one (H1(U,O*) embeds in H1 of any refinement, by sheaf-gluing of the comparison units a_z*gamma(i,z)^-1), giving CechPic.mk_eq_one_iff/mk_injective; sections over affine opens V of any test T pull back bijectively along pr : C x T -> T (qcqs pushout square with the affine slot on the T side, flatness over a field is free), injectively over arbitrary opens; prPullback_injective for arbitrary T by descending the trivializing units through a fiber section. All axiom-clean.
